name: Lay Down Misére
source:
Selica is used to scraping by to survive in a poor town. But when a job has her skimming money from the shady casino above the town, things go poorly. The cheerful, power-hungry Ludmilla and her dependable bodyguard Eleanor ensure that Selica's life is forever altered, in their own ways.

[From [url=https://sarlianna.itch.io/lay-down-misere]itch.io[/url]]
